player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({role}) in a {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies game.
- Each round, submit [heads] or [tails] (or [h], [t]).
- If your choice matches your opponent’s, Player 0 wins the round; otherwise Player 1 wins.
Reply with your choice in the format '[heads]' or '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Napili an Player 0 an '{choice0}'; Napili an Player 1 an '{choice1}'. Match -> Player 0 an nagdaog
message.round_mismatch: Napili an Player 0 an '{choice0}'; Napili an Player 1 an '{choice1}'. Mismatch -> Player 1 an nagdaog.

outcome.p0_wins: An Player 0 nagdaog hin damo nga mga round.
outcome.p1_wins: An manlalaro 1 an nagdaog hin damo nga mga round.
outcome.draw: An kabug-osan nga duwa waray magkatatapos.
